column1: # examples/cx-lab/charclass.tsv -- lab table: normalizes raw bytes into lexical classes.
#   kind NL     : c == '\n' (checked before generic whitespace)
#   kind EXACT  : c == lit (lit is the single literal character in column 3)
#   kind PUNCT  : ispunct(c), catch-all after the EXACT rows above it
# Rows are tried top to bottom; the first match wins. No row matching -> class OTHER.
# Read by examples/cx-lab/lex_table.cx; not used by anything outside this lab.

column3:
SLASH	EXACT	/
STAR	EXACT	*
OP	PUNCT
